message: Hi, my little one Eli is 5 and wants to try jiu jitsu. Do you have classes for that age?

Hi! Yes, we do! We have Kids Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu for ages 3 to 13. Eli would be a great fit. The classes focus on self-defense and building confidence in a fun, safe environment. Would you like to book a free trial class for him?
Yes, I would love to book a free trial class for Eli! What time do you have available?
Perfect! I just need a few quick details to get your trial set up. What's your name?
Great, thanks Tester! Can I get your email address? That way I can send you the confirmation and class details.
Perfect! And what's the best phone number to reach you at?
Got it! Now I just need Eli's full name and date of birth to get him signed up for the trial.
Eli's full name is Eli Aspen, and his birthday is April 22, 2021.

Perfect! I have Eli all set. Here are some available times for his free trial class:

- Thursday, July 9 at 5:00 PM
- Monday, July 13 at 5:00 PM
- Thursday, July 16 at 5:00 PM

Which works best for you?
Let's go with Thursday, July 9 at 5:00 PM. Thank you!

Perfect! Eli is all booked for Thursday, July 9 at 5:00 PM. You'll get a confirmation email at tester.aspen@gmail.com with all the details. Just bring Eli in comfortable clothes he can move in. We're excited to meet him!
